you have two major groupings, deep in your brain.
The limbic system.
It's the first system to develop.

It's where all the core stuff is
hunger, thirst, elimination, wakes,

fright is oh, the scary part.
Flight is the get away from this,
this is dangerous part.
And fight is I want what I want and the drive towards something.
